subject: CONFIRMED SOURCE RACE: global opening-start flag can orphan replacement cover engine
body: WORKSTREAM_ID=ws-state-rd-opening-owner-20261001T230257Z. MAIN=45bb0d326899c0e08415928224cfea0ff58d2d4e. Source reconstruction confirms FoldOverlayService owns service-global earlyOpeningVisualLatched + earlyOpeningVisualStarted, while actual effect lifetime is instance-local PanelEngine.continuityOpeningVisual. syncDisplays() destroys gone engines and creates replacements keyed by logical display ID before reconcile. Reconcile starts a cover engine only when earlyOpeningVisualStarted=false. Therefore: accepted opening -> engine A starts -> A destroyed/remapped -> service global started remains true -> replacement cover engine B is eligible/owned but beginContinuityOpeningVisual() is skipped. Deterministic reduced source-faithful model reproduces this lost-visual state. Second source issue: reconcile clears earlyOpeningVisualLatched whenever coverEngines.isEmpty(), so a transient route gap consumes the accepted semantic opening attempt even though controller intentionally preserves OPENING_FROM_CLOSED/INNER_HANDOFF across topology churn. Narrow Gen3 direction: exact stable opening-attempt identity independent of host; host loss stops binding but preserves current demand; replacement host rebinds same attempt; cancel only on semantic state exit, privilege/authority loss, exact timeout, service epoch change, or explicit user stop. Timeout callbacks should carry exact attempt identity. Pure model currently PASS=12/12 including 100,000-event fixed-seed adversarial stream. No production writes.
